What is the essential teaching in 'The Marvel of the Dhamma'?

In 'The Marvel of the Dhamma', the teaching opens with this observation: *"Those who practice the Dhamma will begin to know the Dhamma or to gain a feel for the Dhamma in the area of meditation more markedly than in other areas, and more extensively."* The central invitation is to turn one's investigation inward — to verify the Dhamma not as a set of beliefs, but as directly observable reality in one's own body, speech, and mind. There is no need to search elsewhere; the truth is already here.
